name: records
description: High scores that outlive a game, and the last result that outlives a scene: a Record follows a number of the game (the score of the player), keeps the best it has seen and the last, and saves the best under a name so that the next run of the program starts with it.

components.name: Record
components.description: Follows the number field (written "module.Component.field", as for a Bind) of the entity tagged source, as long as that entity exists. last is the latest value seen: it stays when the source is gone, so a game over screen can show the score of the game that just ended. best is the highest value ever seen; it starts from what was saved under key (a name of the game's "record" list) on the first tick, and is saved again each time it grows. Give the entity a scene_switch.Persistent to keep it from scene to scene, and a tag.Tag so that a Bind can show best and last. Saved values are whole numbers; the save is kept by the program that plays the game (geplay writes it to the player's application-data folder; a scenario starts empty).

systems.name: track
systems.description: Loads the best of every Record on its first tick, then follows its source: last takes the value, best and the saved value rise with it.
